scenes.headline: How a pixel diffusion model guides itself
scenes.sub: Representation Guidance: a bottleneck, and a shifted training target.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Lodestar! This paper trains an image generator straight on pixels, and teaches it to lean on its own compact summary.

scenes.text: Squeeze the encoder's output through a narrow bottleneck, then train the decoder toward a target pushed further along what that bottleneck adds.
scenes.mark: pushed further along what that bottleneck adds
scenes.say: Squeeze the middle of the network through a narrow bottleneck. Then train the decoder toward a target pushed further along what that bottleneck adds.

scenes.title: One plain Transformer, cut in two

steps.say: Noisy patches go into an encoder of ordinary Transformer blocks.
Its output is squeezed through a linear bottleneck a hundred and twenty-eight numbers wide.
The decoder reads the noisy patches again, and sees the encoder only through that compact representation.
It predicts the clean image. One time in ten the representation is dropped, so the decoder also learns without it.

parts.note: what the representation changes in the prediction
parts.say: Run the decoder with and without the representation. The difference is what the representation contributes.
Scale that difference by s minus one. The default s is one point four.
Stop its gradient, so it acts as a fixed nudge.

parts.note: the target the decoder must now hit
parts.say: Add it to the usual flow matching target. To hit it, the representation has to carry more of the picture.

scenes.title: Guidance at sampling, or in training

left.title: Classifier-free guidance
left.say: Classifier-free guidance extrapolates at sampling time, with a fixed label, and pays an extra forward pass.

right.title: Representation Guidance
right.say: This method moves the extrapolation into training. The condition is learned, and sampling costs nothing extra.

scenes.title: ImageNet 256, FID, lower is better
scenes.note: one run each; 1.79 against 1.82 is a tie
scenes.say: On ImageNet, the large model matches a two billion parameter baseline with a quarter of the weights. The four times speed-up counts epochs; in compute it is closer to two.

scenes.text: A representation helps generation only if the model is made to depend on it, not just to contain it.
scenes.say: A representation helps generation only when the model is made to depend on it, not just to contain it.

recap: Shifted target makes the decoder use it
Guidance learned in training, free at sampling
scenes.say: A bottleneck forms it, a shifted target makes the decoder use it, and the guidance costs nothing at sampling.
